snippet.title: Sorcery Slam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Sorcery Slam is a competitive/party puzzle game inspired by retro era classics. Play with up to 6 Sorcerers locally or online to collect powerful elemental Gems and be the first to power up your ultimate final blast for the win!

Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276960/Sorcery_Slam/

Join the Discord
https://discord.gg/6CpRbKHneu

More information on our website!
https://sorceryslam.com/
